2021-2022 Percentage of students who were enrolled for at least 10 days in a school/district who are chronically absent from school. A student is defined as chronically absent when they are enrolled in a NC public school for at least 10 school days at any time during the school year, and whose total number of absences is = or > 10% of the total number of days that the student has been enrolled at any school during a given school year.
